clue.text: Make a simple alteration in the preceding although it has all been rubbed out

definitions.text: it has all been rubbed out

indicators.note: in places the reworked letters inside the word for preceding

parts.note: past means preceding, as in the past week

indicators.note: making an alteration to the word simple rearranges its letters

explanation.surface: An editor tidies up the previous passage while an earlier text has been erased.
explanation.walkthrough: LIMPSE, the anagram of SIMPLE signalled by 'alteration', goes inside PAST ('in'), splitting it PA...ST.
explanation.definitionFit: A palimpsest is a manuscript whose original writing was scraped away so the parchment could be reused.

clue.text: Roguish chief

explanation.surface: A leader with a mischievous streak.
explanation.definitionFit: Arch means mischievously playful, as in an arch smile, and is also a prefix-like adjective for principal, as in arch-enemy.

clue.text: Place which is needed for national defence

indicators.note: the letters needed are taken from within the following words, a run inside them

explanation.surface: A location essential to the country's defence.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits inside 'national'; 'which is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Iona is a small island off western Scotland, famous for its abbey, so it is a place.

clue.text: Religious body formed by previous youth

parts.note: prior means previous, earlier
Y is a common abbreviation for youth, as in YMCA

explanation.surface: A church group founded by a young person from before.
explanation.definitionFit: A priory is a community of monks or nuns governed by a prior, a religious house.

clue.text: Athletic contest to give encouragement and make love?

parts.note: to egg on is to encourage
spoon is an old word for kiss and cuddle
a race is a contest of speed

explanation.surface: A sports day event to cheer on and to court?
explanation.definitionFit: The egg-and-spoon race is a children's sports-day event carrying an egg on a spoon.

clue.text: A kind of acid produced by a girl during a twitch

indicators.note: during puts the girl in the middle of the twitch

parts.note: a tic is an involuntary twitch
Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A chemist's daughter twitches while making acid.
explanation.definitionFit: Tannic acid is the astringent compound found in tea and oak bark.

clue.text: Returned with meat or game

parts.note: back means returned, as in came back
gammon is cured ham, a meat

explanation.surface: Someone came home with meat or game from the hunt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Game' looks like the hunted meat of the surface, but it is the definition: a board game.
explanation.definitionFit: Backgammon is a board game for two played with dice and counters.

clue.text: Stop an article on a question

indicators.note: on means the article is placed after the question in an across entry

parts.note: who is a question word
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Halt a newspaper piece about a query.
explanation.definitionFit: Whoa is the call to make a horse stop, used generally to mean stop or slow down.

clue.text: Rider whom reason sent astray

indicators.note: sent astray means the letters of these words are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A jockey whose logic has been led off course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent astray' rearranges WHOM and REASON together.
explanation.definitionFit: A horsewoman is a woman who rides horses, a female rider.

clue.text: Group of soldiers who are against a man of metal

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
tin is a metal
gent is short for gentleman, a man

explanation.surface: Troops opposed to a robot made of metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A contingent is a body of troops supplied to a larger force.

clue.text: Last report about Kelvin's journey

indicators.note: last takes only the final letter of the word report

parts.note: re means about, concerning
K is the symbol for the kelvin unit of temperature

explanation.surface: The final account of Kelvin's travels.
explanation.definitionFit: A trek is a long arduous journey, especially on foot.

clue.text: Bird without day of victory for a hungry person

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the bird surrounds the victory letters

parts.note: a starling is a common bird
VE Day was Victory in Europe day, 8 May 1945

explanation.surface: A bird with nothing to celebrate goes hungry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is the old sense outside, not lacking: STARLING wraps VE.
explanation.definitionFit: A starveling is a person or animal that is starving or underfed.

clue.text: Crazy when it is back in the money

indicators.note: in places the turned letters inside the currency

parts.note: the franc was the currency of France and other countries

indicators.note: is back means the word it is read backwards

explanation.surface: Frenzy when the cash comes back in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is back' turns IT to TI, which goes 'in' FRANC.
explanation.definitionFit: Frantic means wildly agitated, beside oneself, so crazy.

clue.text: Painter as legendary figure embracing a girl

indicators.note: embracing means the legendary figure wraps round the girl

parts.note: Faust is the scholar of legend who sold his soul to the Devil
Vi is a girl's name, short for Violet

explanation.surface: An artist cast as a figure of myth hugging a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A Fauvist was a painter of the Fauve school, like Matisse, known for wild colour.

clue.text: Expression of grief about the Tate being converted into accommodation for animals

indicators.note: about means the cry goes round the converted letters

parts.note: a cry is an expression of grief

indicators.note: being converted means the letters of Tate are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A lament that the Tate gallery is being turned into an animal shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being converted' turns TATE into ATTE, which CRY goes 'about'. The Tate is a London art gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: A cattery is a place where cats are boarded or bred, housing for animals.

clue.text: Missing coin found beside a salver

indicators.note: found beside puts the two pieces next to each other

parts.note: the as was a Roman coin
a salver is a tray

explanation.surface: A lost coin turns up next to a serving plate.
explanation.definitionFit: Astray means gone off the right path, lost or missing.

clue.text: Woman with explosive charge holds industrious creature to be unshakeable

parts.note: Ada is a woman's name

indicators.note: holds means the explosive charge contains the creature

parts.note: a mine is an explosive charge
the ant is proverbially hard-working

explanation.surface: A woman with a bomb takes a busy insect hostage and stays firm.
explanation.definitionFit: Adamantine means as hard as adamant, unbreakable or unyielding.

clue.text: When I leave America it turns into a place for films

indicators.note: turns into signals that the remaining letters are rearranged
leave means the letter I departs from the word America

parts.note: America is used as written before the I is removed

explanation.surface: If one man left the United States, it would become a film studio.
explanation.walkthrough: With 'I leave', AMERICA loses its I to give AMERCA, which 'turns into' a new order.
explanation.definitionFit: A camera is where photographic film is loaded and exposed.

clue.text: Destination of competing dish for being held by a limb

indicators.note: being held by means the following pieces sit inside the limb

parts.note: the arm is a limb
rival means competing
plat is French for a dish, as in plat du jour
taken as written

explanation.surface: Where a rival's dish ends up when someone clutches it under an arm.
explanation.walkthrough: RIVAL, PLAT and FOR go inside ARM, splitting it AR...M.
explanation.definitionFit: The arrival platform is where a train ends its journey, its destination at the station.

clue.text: Some poetry makes one hostile

parts.note: a means one
verse is poetry

explanation.surface: A few lines of poetry put someone in a bad mood.
explanation.definitionFit: Averse means opposed or strongly disinclined, which is hostile in sense.

clue.text: Way in which Red Sea could be blotted out

indicators.note: could be signals that the letters of the words may form something else

explanation.surface: A method by which the Red Sea might be wiped away.
explanation.definitionFit: Erased means rubbed out or obliterated, so blotted out.

clue.text: Make a decree and one is turned to gold.

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry

indicators.note: is turned means the letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A royal order makes a coin turn to gold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is turned' rearranges AND plus I to DAIN, which follows OR ('to').
explanation.definitionFit: To ordain is to order or decree officially.

clue.text: Futile as it arises in an ancient language

indicators.note: in places the turned letters inside the ancient language

parts.note: OE is short for Old English

indicators.note: arises in a down clue means the two words are read upwards, backwards

parts.note: so means as, as in do it so

explanation.surface: Something pointless as it emerges in a dead tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arises' turns SO IT into TIOS, which goes 'in' OE.
explanation.definitionFit: Otiose means serving no practical purpose, so futile.

clue.text: Contained' by, it in an attempt to make three

indicators.note: in places both pieces inside the attempt

parts.note: a try is an attempt

indicators.note: by means the contained word sits beside it

parts.note: in means contained, as in tucked in

explanation.surface: A rugby try with something inside makes up a set of three.
explanation.walkthrough: IN and IT go 'in' TRY. The stray apostrophe after Contained is a print mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The Trinity is the Christian doctrine of three persons in one God, a threesome.

clue.text: This king would be using his brain although it is slight

indicators.note: this plus a king would be the thinking word, so the king is removed from it

parts.note: to think is to use one's brain
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A monarch who reasons, though his frame is slender.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue says this word plus K would be THINK; remove the K to find it.
explanation.definitionFit: Thin means slight, slender or meagre.

clue.text: See a hundred and one places

parts.note: lo is an old word for see or behold
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Visit a hundred and one locations.
explanation.definitionFit: Loci is the plural of locus, Latin for place or position.

clue.text: Ancient place for revolutionary?

explanation.surface: Where an old rebel came from.
explanation.definitionFit: Tyre was an ancient Phoenician city, and a car's wheel covering revolves, so the second sense is something that goes round.

clue.text: Way of getting out of it which makes parental guidance easy and cool

definitions.text: Way of getting out of it

indicators.note: makes signals the letters are worked into a new arrangement

parts.note: PG is the film certificate for parental guidance

explanation.surface: An escape method that turns supervised viewing into a relaxed affair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'makes' rearranges PG, EASY and COOL together.
explanation.definitionFit: Escapology is the art of freeing oneself from chains and locks, as Houdini did.

clue.text: In this gang these animals are back

indicators.note: are back means the found letters are read in the opposite direction
in means the letters are found inside the words this gang

explanation.surface: Within this gang the beasts have returned.
explanation.definitionFit: Nags are horses, especially old or worn-out ones.
